quick.topic: Use the median for lopsided numbers
quick.summary: Why the average order can be ninety when most are twenty.
quick.takeaway: When a few are huge, use the middle one.

parts.title: Use the median for lopsided numbers

beats.line: Average order is ninety. Most orders are about twenty. How can both be true?
A few huge orders pull the average up.
Five orders. Four of twenty, one of three hundred and seventy.
The average is ninety. Nobody spent ninety.
The median is the middle order when you sort them. Twenty.
So the average is just wrong?
No. It is right for total revenue. The median shows the typical order.
Typical order is twenty. A few big buyers lift the average.
Both numbers, each for the question it answers.

quiz.question: Orders are mostly small, with a few very large ones. Which number best shows a typical order?
quiz.explanation: The median is the middle value, so a few huge orders do not pull it up.

quiz.question: When a few values are very large, the average can be far from what most people do.
quiz.explanation: The large values pull the average up, while most values sit much lower.
